    Behind the board

    Advisory council

    Experienced former NovUM members who advise the board, share what they learned and help keep the party on course.

      In confidence

      Confidential person

      Has something happened within NovUM that made you feel unsafe or uncomfortable, or that you'd rather not discuss with the board? You can talk to our confidential person. They listen, keep what you share private and help you decide what to do next. Nothing happens without your consent.

      Want to talk to the board?

      Questions about NovUM, a collaboration with your study association, or an idea for a campaign? Send us a message and the right board member will reply. Looking for your councillor? Use the contact form and choose your council.
